# netbox_rack_type (Resource)

Manages a NetBox rack type (`/api/dcim/rack-types/`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
resource "netbox_rack_type" "example" {
  manufacturer_id = netbox_manufacturer.example.id
  model = "example"
  slug = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `manufacturer_id` (Number) ID of the Manufacturer (`netbox_manufacturer`).
- `model` (String) Model.
- `slug` (String) Slug.

### Optional

- `comments` (String) Comments. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `cooling_capability` (String) Cooling Capability. Valid values: `air-only`, `hybrid`, `liquid-only`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `cooling_capacity` (Number) Cooling capacity (kW).
- `custom_fields` (String) Custom field values as a JSON object (`jsonencode({...})`). Only keys present in the configuration are tracked.
- `desc_units` (Boolean) Units are numbered top-to-bottom. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `form_factor` (String) Form Factor. Valid values: `2-post-frame`, `4-post-frame`, `4-post-cabinet`, `wall-frame`, `wall-frame-vertical`, `wall-cabinet`, `wall-cabinet-vertical`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `max_weight` (Number) Maximum load capacity for the rack.
- `mounting_depth` (Number) Maximum depth of a mounted device, in millimeters. For four-post racks, this is the distance between the front and rear rails.
- `outer_depth` (Number) Outer dimension of rack (depth).
- `outer_height` (Number) Outer dimension of rack (height).
- `outer_unit` (String) Outer Unit. Valid values: `mm`, `in`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `outer_width` (Number) Outer dimension of rack (width).
- `owner_id` (Number) ID of the Owner (`netbox_owner`).
- `starting_unit` (Number) Starting unit for rack. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to this object. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `u_height` (Number) Height in rack units. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `weight` (Number) Weight.
- `weight_unit` (String) Weight Unit. Valid values: `kg`, `g`, `lb`, `oz`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `width` (Number) Rail-to-rail width. Valid values: `10`, `19`, `21`, `23`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Created.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `url` (String) Url.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
# netbox_rack_type can be imported by its NetBox object ID.
terraform import netbox_rack_type.example 123
```
